steps.en: Install one first-party plugin from the marketplace
steps.zh: 从 marketplace 装一个一等插件

steps.en: Registers that plugin's SKILL.md descriptions for this session
steps.zh: 把该插件的 SKILL.md 描述注册进本会话

steps.en: Ask for the empirical task in natural language
steps.zh: 用自然语言说要做的实证任务

steps.en: Matches the description and loads one child skill
steps.zh: 按描述匹配，只加载那一个子 skill

steps.en: Point it at your data and confirm the identification strategy
steps.zh: 给出数据，确认识别策略

steps.en: Runs estimation, robustness, and journal tables, then stops for you
steps.zh: 跑估计、稳健性和期刊表格，然后停下来等你

value.en: A method-specific empirical run without loading 1,096 skills or writing the pipeline yourself
value.zh: 不用装 1096 个 skill，也不用自己写流水线提示，就能跑完一次方法对口的实证

sources: INSTALL.md method 1 (marketplace add + plugin install slash commands)
SKILL.md Workflow steps 1–2 (route to one child SKILL.md, do not load the catalog)
